fixed_inputs.rule: Only the episode stores and replay anchors below are consumed. Episode files are deduplicated by repository-relative path; an episode reused as a comparator by another branch is mined once and carries all of its branch memberships.

reused_comparators.unseen: outputs/expanded-study/v1/baseline/episodes/<modality>/expanded-final__<task>/bfs-<arm>.json.gz for arm in process_sft, random_valid, exact_reference
reused_comparators.development: outputs/matched_modalities/v5/evaluation/<modality>/matched-final__<task>/bfs-<arm>.json.gz for arm in process_sft, random_valid, exact_reference

exclusions: view bundles: any path containing '-views' or '/views/'
transfer, second-backbone and historical v5/v4 branches: outside the issue's five named sources
v5 development-task comparator episodes enter only through their dagger/curriculum branch membership

arm_classification.notes: random_valid is an oracle-assisted valid-operation control, never a learned policy; exact_reference and trusted_successor are reference bounds. Curriculum arms embed modality__ordering; modality is taken from the episode field, ordering from the arm suffix.

failure_taxonomy.first_failure_event: The first episode event with accepted == false; verified to always be the terminal event for invalid-operation terminations. Episodes terminating in expansion_budget_exhausted have no rejected event; their failure position is the final decision_count.

search_policy_kinds.definition: raw_output is not a parseable JSON object or lacks the operation payload required by the algorithm schema (best-first: action plus source_state_id; bfs: typed_operation with either action or operation_type).
Parsed action operation whose source_state_id differs from the failing event's current state id.
Action name never appears in any successor_candidates set of any event of the episode.
Action name appears among episode candidate names, but the grounded (name, args) operation is not in the failing event's successor_candidates.
Parsed frontier operation (typed_operation with operation_type/state_id) that was rejected; the precise BFS invariant violated is not recoverable from the episode log alone.
Parsed action operation passing all checks above but still rejected (e.g. frontier_intent inconsistencies not decidable from the log).
Termination without any rejected operation: the expansion budget ran out before the goal.

failure_taxonomy.successor_kind_rule: Taken verbatim from the episode event verification.failure_kind.
failure_taxonomy.escape_kind: unclassified is an explicit escape that must remain zero; any nonzero count is reported as an analysis defect, never silently dropped.

grouping_keys.horizon_position: first-failure decision index (0-based); distribution reported over frozen buckets
grouping_keys.horizon_ratio: first_failure_step / reference_decisions, where reference_decisions is the same task+algorithm+modality exact_reference decision_count in the same store (successor episodes carry their own reference_decisions); missing reference yields null and is counted
grouping_keys.operation_type: Action name of the first failing operation; frontier:<operation_type> for rejected BFS frontier operations; null for expansion_budget_exhausted
grouping_keys.frontier_branching_difficulty: At the first-failure event (final event for budget exhaustions): frontier_size, branching_factor (successor candidate count), visited/known-state count, and current g/h where the best-first schema logs them; reported over frozen buckets

tiny_strata_rule.rule: Any stratum with fewer than 8 episodes is reported as descriptive-only, listed explicitly in the analysis document, and never silently pooled across strata or dropped.

missingness_rule: Coverage and missingness are stated per source branch in the analysis document, including scope reductions frozen by the source branches (generalization v2: 2 of 4 algorithm families, 25 of 120 variants, 6 of 12 adapters, base arm capped at one call; successor: 15 of 27 panel tasks; dagger: bfs only; curriculum: best_first_add_greedy only).
claim_discipline: Descriptive only: no causal claims beyond what the underlying verified experiments established.
random_valid is oracle-assisted; controls are bounds, not learned ability.
P3 name-compression lossy strata are reported separately and never pooled with semantics-preserving variants.
v5 development-task comparator episodes carry no schema_version but entered only via replay-verified dagger/curriculum audits.
Single training seed 17 and evaluation seed 17 underlie all learned arms; no seed-variance claims.
